# Skilldotpy — NIELIT O Level & CCC Study Material Platform

> Skilldotpy is India's #1 free and paid learning platform for NIELIT O Level (M1-R5, M2-R5, M3-R5, M4-R5) and CCC exam preparation. Founded by Er. Aditya Pathak.

## What We Offer

- **Chapter-Wise Notes**: Free bilingual (Hindi + English) notes for all 32+ chapters across O Level M1, M2, M3, M4 and CCC.
- **Chapter-Wise MCQs**: Instant practice tests with explanations for every chapter of every module.
- **CBT Mock Tests**: Full-length 100-question timed mock tests simulating NIELIT's real CBT exam environment.
- **Practical Exam IDE**: Browser-based code runners for Python, HTML/CSS/JS, and Arduino IoT practical exams.
- **Paid Video Courses**: HD video masterclasses for all 4 O Level modules + CCC with lifetime access.
- **Syllabus & Result Calculator**: Latest R5.1 syllabus breakdowns and O Level grade calculator tool.
- **Free PDF Downloads**: Downloadable chapter-wise PDF notes, previous year papers, and cheat sheets.
- **Android App**: Full-featured Android app with offline mode, video lectures, and mock tests.

## Target Exams & Subjects

### NIELIT O Level (R5.1)
- **M1-R5**: IT Tools & Network Basics (9 chapters — Computer Fundamentals, Operating Systems, LibreOffice Writer/Calc/Impress, Networking & Internet, Cybersecurity)
- **M2-R5**: Web Designing & Publishing (8 chapters — HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, Responsive Design, Web Hosting)
- **M3-R5**: Programming & Problem Solving through Python (9 chapters — Algorithms, Python Basics, Control Flow, Data Structures, Functions, File Handling, NumPy)
- **M4-R5**: Internet of Things & its Applications (6 chapters — IoT Architecture, Sensors, Arduino, Raspberry Pi, Cloud & IoT, IoT Applications)

### NIELIT CCC (Course on Computer Concepts)
- 9 chapters covering Computer Fundamentals, LibreOffice Suite, Internet & Email, Digital Financial Tools, Cybersecurity, Future Skills
